title: A Song About Jazz
style: Future bass fused with jazz harmony: lush extended chords on Rhodes and detuned soft-synth pads, chopped vocal-style lead on a plucky FM synth, and syncopated 808 sub-bass with sidechain pumping. Live ride cymbal, ghost-note snare, brushed percussion, and upright bass accents keep it fluid and warm.
lyrics:
[Verse]
Come on, it's lovely weather
To have a song about jazz, jazz
In an onomatopoeia
Like a "bee bop" and "ba-zazz-zazz"
And I'll scattin' like I'm leavin'
A bag in a Parisian
Cafe and turnin' back to hear
A song about jazz
And the intro's just a low trombone
A woodwind drone, you know the rest
And the ending's a suspended chord
Of course, like, I guess
Well, I do declare
We're overdue for a song about jazz
Oh, yeah

[Chorus]
You know what we should do?
We should write a song about jazz
It doesn't have to be long
It can be all night long
[Bridge]
